scripts.build: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && prisma generate && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.db:setup: pnpm run contracts:build && prisma generate && tsx scripts/ensure-database-file.ts && prisma migrate deploy && tsx apps/api/src/seed.ts
scripts.dev: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && prisma generate && tsx scripts/ensure-database-file.ts && prisma migrate deploy && tsx apps/api/src/seed.ts && node scripts/start-development.mjs
scripts.test: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && prisma generate && vitest run apps/api/tests
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && prisma generate && tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run test:a11y && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:migrations && pnpm run verify:living-plan
